title: Activity list
responsibility: Shows an initial portion of a supplied list with a control to reveal the rest.

inputs.name: ActivityList.items
inputs.description: Required list of generic items in display order. Every row is rendered; rows beyond the preview are hidden while collapsed.

inputs.name: ActivityList.label
inputs.description: Required accessible list name, also normalized into the list ID used by the expansion control.

inputs.name: ActivityList.noun
inputs.description: Required item name used in Show all/Show fewer button text.

inputs.name: ActivityList.preview
inputs.description: Required number of initial visible positions. Used directly without clamping or integer validation.

inputs.name: ActivityList.ordered
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default. True renders an ordered list, false an unordered list.

inputs.name: ActivityList.row
inputs.description: Required snippet called with each item to render its row.

outputs.name: ActivityList
outputs.description: Accessible list with hidden overflow rows and a toggle only when item count exceeds preview. Starts collapsed. Row content is not lazily created on expansion.
